description.html: This 60x50x90 cm terrarium (270 L) comes with a polystyrene 3D background that faithfully reproduces the texture of stone or bark. Hand-sculpted and painted in natural tones, the background is more than decoration: it adds surfaces for climbing and hiding.

With a height of 90 cm that exceeds its 60 cm length, this terrarium is designed for climbing species. The vertical space allows a layered setup with branches and platforms at different heights. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

items: Crested geckos kept as a pair

description.html: Because we build every terrarium by hand, we adapt it to your requirements, from dimensions and film to the background and ventilation system. Call or write to us for free advice and a quote. We ship to every city in Serbia.
